content:
Block Pack adds 1200+ building blocks. Build literally anything.

📋 About

Block Pack adds over 1200 building and decoration blocks to Minecraft - one mod, every style. Build in medieval, Japanese, Greek, cyberpunk, modern, or underwater themes from a single pack. Made for vanilla builders who want more shapes, more detail, and full customization without losing the base-game feel.

🧱 More Than Decoration

Block Pack blocks actually do things:
  • Fillable storage - crates, fish barrels, baskets and sacks: right-click to stash items and pull them back out.
  • Lights everywhere - paper lanterns and hanging lamps that sway on their chains, neon signs, string lights, candlesticks in every color, and glowing hologram blocks.
  • Living streets - air conditioners, smoking chimneys, weather vanes, vents and gutters that bring a town to life.
  • The Wrench - change block states and swap variants right in the world, no menus.
  • A custom Wandering Trader - roaming your world with exclusive Block Pack goods.

🔨 The Workbench

Every block is crafted at the Workbench, a dedicated station with its own recipe book - so 1200 fresh recipes never clutter your vanilla crafting table.

🔧 Compatibility

Full support for JEI, EMI, Jade, and Chipped.

🚀 Supported Versions

  • 1.21.1 - NeoForge · Fabric
  • 1.20.1 - Forge · Fabric
Fabric requires the Fabric API.
